name: Acadia Realty Trust
outlook:
What Acadia Realty Trust says to expect

  • Full year 2026: same-property NOI growthSame-property NOI grew 10.2% for the third quarter of 2026 compared with the third quarter of 2025, primarily driven by 15.2% growth from the street retail portfolio. Same-property NOI growth for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 was 8.3% compared to the same period in 2025, and the Company anticipates full-year 2026 same-property NOI growth of 7.5% to 8.5%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
